parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;

const findingsJson = JSON.stringify(d.findings.slice(0, 20), null, 2);

const prompt = [
  'You are a product intelligence analyst writing a weekly digest for a Director of Product at Ping Identity.',
  'Your reader is a senior PM — they know CIAM, read this fast, and are frustrated when recycled standing observations are framed as new weekly news.',
  '',
  'Week: ' + d.week,
  'Findings this week (' + d.findings_count + ' total):',
  findingsJson,
  '',
  'System health: ' + d.error_count + ' errors this week.',
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  'STEP 1 — EVALUATE NOVELTY BEFORE WRITING ANYTHING',
  '',
  'For each finding, inspect the "what_changed" field and the evidence. A finding is NOVEL only if at least one of these is true this week:',
  '- New source URL not previously seen',
  '- Page content changed with a meaningful delta (new feature, new version, new release note entry)',
  '- New changelog or release note entry published this week',
  '- New capability evidence not previously documented',
  '- Interpretation or confidence materially changed',
  '',
  'If none are true → it is a STANDING OBSERVATION. Do not place it in NEW THIS WEEK.',
  '',
  'REPEAT SUPPRESSION: If the same conclusion appeared in a prior newsletter (e.g. "Okta has MCP release notes", "Okta Sign-In Widget covers multiple frameworks") and nothing material changed this week, do NOT restate it as a new move. Put it in Ongoing Watch instead.',
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  'STEP 2 — WRITE THE NEWSLETTER USING THIS EXACT STRUCTURE:',
  '',
  '## NEW THIS WEEK',
  'Only genuinely novel findings. For each item you must explicitly answer:',
  '- [Company] — [specific product or capability] — What changed this week: [one sentence]. Why newly important this week: [one sentence]. Competitive implication for Ping: [gap / parity / advantage].',
  '  Sources: [label](url)',
  '',
  'If you cannot answer "what changed this week" in one clear sentence for an item, it does NOT belong here.',
  'If nothing is genuinely new, write exactly: Nothing material changed this week — see Ongoing Watch below.',
  '',
  '## ONGOING WATCH',
  'Standing observations that remain strategically important but had no new movement this week. 1–2 bullets max.',
  'These are signals to monitor, not this week\'s news. No Sources lines here.',
  '',
  '## RECOMMENDED ACTIONS',
  '1–2 max. Only include if tied to a finding in NEW THIS WEEK. Omit this section entirely if nothing is new.',
  '',
  '## SYSTEM HEALTH',
  'One line.',
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  'RULES',
  '- A short honest newsletter beats a padded stale one. Quiet week = say so directly.',
  '- Never put an item in NEW THIS WEEK without explicitly stating what changed and why it matters now.',
  '- Name the specific product or capability — no vague phrases.',
  '- Do not use internal vocabulary: no production_mature, confidence_score, evidence_summary, review_flag.',
  '- Label low-confidence items [LOW CONFIDENCE].',
  '- Max 500 words.',
  '- Always use ## for section headers and - for bullet points.'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { ...d, prompt } }];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 2048, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: 'YOUR_NOTION_NEWSLETTERS_DB_ID' }, properties: { Name: { title: [{ text: { content: 'Weekly Intel \u2014 ' + $json.week_label } }] }, Week: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.week } }] }, 'Findings Count': { number: $json.findings_count }, 'Generated At': { rich_text: [{ text: { content: $json.generated_at } }] } }, children: [$json.newsletter_content.substring(0,2000), $json.newsletter_content.substring(2000,4000), $json.newsletter_content.substring(4000,6000)].filter(s => s.length > 0).map(chunk => ({ object: 'block', type: 'paragraph', paragraph: { rich_text: [{ type: 'text', text: { content: chunk } }] } })) }) }}
